Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Provision of signed and dated informed consent form
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has provided written informed consent, as explicitly stated in the patient description.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no explicit information in the patient description about the patient's willingness or availability for the study.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Male or female, aged ≥ 18 and < 71 years
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is a 47-year-old female, which fits within the age range specified.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Diagnosed with - Acute leukemias or T-lymphoblastic lymphoma (T-LBL) in 1st or subsequent CR
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is diagnosed with metastatic breast cancer, not acute leukemia or T-LBL.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Acute lymphocytic leukemia (ALL) or T-LBL as defined by the following: - < 5% blasts in the bone marrow - Normal maturation of all cellular components in the bone marrow - No currently active extramedullary disease (EMD) (e.g., central nervous system (CNS), soft tissue disease) - ANC ≥ 1,000/mm3
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's diagnosis is metastatic breast cancer, not ALL or T-LBL, and there is no information on bone marrow blasts or ANC.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) defined by the following: - < 5% blasts in the bone marrow - No blasts with Auer rods - Normal maturation of all cellular components in the bone marrow - No currently active EMD (e.g., CNS, soft tissue disease) - ANC ≥ 1,000/mm3
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is diagnosed with metastatic breast cancer, not AML, and there is no information on bone marrow blasts or ANC.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Acute biphenotypic leukemia (ABL)/Acute undifferentiated leukemia (AUL) defined by the following: - < 5% blasts in the bone marrow - Normal maturation of all cellular components in the bone marrow - No currently active EMD (e.g., CNS, soft tissue disease) - ANC ≥ 1,000/mm3
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is diagnosed with metastatic breast cancer, not ABL or AUL, and there is no information on bone marrow blasts or ANC.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Myleodysplastic Syndromes (MDS), fulfilling the following criteria: - Subjects with de novo MDS who have or have previously had Intermediate-2 or High-risk disease as determined by the IPSS. Current Intermediate-2 or High- risk disease is not a requirement - Subjects must have < 20% bone marrow blasts, assessed within 60 days of informed consent - Subjects may have received prior therapy for the treatment of MDS prior to enrollment - Performance status: Karnofsky ≥ 60% - Adequate organ function defined as: - Cardiac: LVEF at rest ≥ 35% (RIC cohort) or LVEF at rest ≥ 40% (FIC cohort), or LVFS ≥ 25% - Pulmonary: DLCO, FEV1, FVC ≥ 50% predicted by pulmonary function tests (PFTs). DLCO value may be corrected or uncorrected for hemoglobin - Hepatic: total bilirubin ≤ 2.5 mg/dL, and ALT, AST, and ALP < 5 x ULN (unless ALT, AST, and/or ALP are disease related) - Renal: SCr within normal range for age (see table 5.1B). If SCr is outside normal range for age, CrCl > 40 mL/min/1.73m2 must be obtained (measured by 24-hour (hr) urine specimen or nuclear glomerular filtration rate (GFR), or calculated GFR (by Cockcroft-Gault formula) - Subjects must have the ability to give informed consent according to applicable regulatory and local institutional requirements
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is diagnosed with metastatic breast cancer, not MDS, and there is no information on bone marrow blasts or organ function.
